solutions.latex:
kJ consumed $= 312.5 \times 4.184 = 1307.5$ kJ

Workout total $= 550 \times 2 = 1100$ kJ in $2$ hours

$1307.5 > 1100$, so no, the workout will not burn it off.

OR: $550$ kJ/hr $= 131.45$ cal/hr, so $262.91$ cal in $2$ hrs; $262.91 < 312.5$, so no.

Time difference $= 13$ hours (Sydney ahead of Brazil).

$1410 + 13$ hrs $= 27$ hrs $10$ min, which is $3$ hrs past $24$.

So $0310$ Monday, or $3{:}10$ am Monday.
